2607.01679.title: Beyond Gradient-Based Attacks: Adversarial Robustness and Explainability Stability in Cybersecurity Classifiers
2607.01679.paper_summary: Adversarial attacks on cybersecurity classifiers pose a dual threat: degrading predictions and destabilising the SHAP-based explanations that security analysts rely on to understand and triage alerts. We extend our prior MLP conference study to Random Forest and XGBoost across four tabular security datasets (phishing URLs, UNSW-NB15, NF-ToN-IoT, HIKARI-2021), evaluating five attacks including three black-box methods applicable to non-differentiable tree models. We introduce the Explainability Stability Index (ESI), a scalar metric computed from TreeSHAP attribution drift under adversarial perturbation, reported on the same [0,1] scale as the Robustness Index (RI). A key finding is that gradient-based black-box attacks (ZOO) produce degenerate results against XGBoost (apparent RI ~0.98) due to piecewise-constant prediction surfaces, while score-based Square Attack reveals genuine vulnerability (RI ~0.36). These degenerate perturbations still drive substantial attribution drift: XGBoost ESI ~0.06-0.16 despite near-perfect ZOO robustness, versus 0.14-0.29 for RF, showing that prediction robustness and explanation stability are distinct axes requiring joint measurement. A two-axis framework (gradient dependence, query efficiency) explains the observed attack ranking and yields practical guidance for tree ensemble evaluation. A step-size ablation explains a counterintuitive PGD anomaly on z-score normalised tabular data.
2607.01679.paper_summary_zh: 對於網絡安全分類器的對抗性攻擊構成了雙重威脅：降低預測準確性並破壞安全分析師依賴以理解和分類警報的基於SHAP的解釋。我們擴展了之前的MLP會議研究，將其應用於隨機森林和XGBoost，涵蓋四個表格安全數據集（網絡釣魚URL、UNSW-NB15、NF-ToN-IoT、HIKARI-2021），評估五種攻擊，包括三種適用於非可微樹模型的黑箱方法。我們引入了解釋穩定性指數（ESI），這是一個從對抗擾動下的TreeSHAP歸因漂移計算得出的標量指標，報告在與穩健性指數（RI）相同的[0,1]範圍內。一個關鍵發現是，基於梯度的黑箱攻擊（ZOO）對XGBoost產生了退化結果（明顯的RI約為0.98），這是由於分段常數預測表面，而基於分數的平方攻擊則揭示了真正的脆弱性（RI約為0.36）。這些退化擾動仍然驅動了實質性的歸因漂移：儘管ZOO的穩健性幾乎完美，XGBoost的ESI仍為約0.06-0.16，而RF則為0.14-0.29，顯示預測穩健性和解釋穩定性是需要聯合測量的不同軸。兩軸框架（梯度依賴性、查詢效率）解釋了觀察到的攻擊排序，並為樹集成評估提供了實用指導。一個步長消融解釋了在z-score標準化表格數據上出現的反直覺PGD異常。
